snippet.title: Eternal Haunt - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A first-person atmospheric survival horror game based on a folklore tale set in old Japan. Inspired by 'Amnesia: The Dark Descent', avoid the deathly cold grasp of Yuki-Onna and her ten ghost children. Solve dynamic puzzles, scavenge for items, piece together this tragic story, and find your lost grandson. Wishlist now and Play the demo; https://store.steampowered.com/app/2900990/Eternal_Haunt/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
